blocks.text: After collection, data must be prepared: cleaned of errors and inconsistencies, organized meaningfully and converted into a suitable format. Where data are missing or wrong, techniques such as interpolation or statistical adjustment may be used; for example, missing survey answers can be estimated from the available data. Proper preparation makes the analysis reliable and valid.

blocks.prompt: List three things data preparation does.
blocks.explanation: It cleans errors and inconsistencies, organizes the data meaningfully, and converts it into a format suitable for analysis (filling or handling missing values).

items: Preparation: clean, organize, convert; handle missing data so results are reliable.
